items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass pane
items.rationale: Remains of insured property, material arising under 5.2.1(a); both elements indemnifiable so the combined line stands. References: glass 30-34, timber below 75.

items.description: Combined load: green waste, root mass over 1 m3, excavated soil
items.rationale: Combined position mixing indemnifiable green waste with root mass over 1 m3 (5.2.1(e)) and ground material (5.2.1(d)); under 7.1.10 the whole line is not indemnified.
Ground material under 5.2.1(d); no reinstatement ground works and ground not made good, so 5.2.2 is not met. Standalone disposal is not indemnified.
Ground material however processed, 5.2.1(d); standalone clearance without reinstatement is excluded under 5.2.2.
